products.title: Product slugs
products.description: Alternative to URLs: TrustRadius slugs like slack, hubspot-crm, jira.

maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product
maxReviewsPerProduct.description: TrustRadius shows 10 reviews per page, newest first.

includeProductInfo.title: Include product info row
includeProductInfo.description: One row per product with overall rating and review count.

includeReviewerInfo.title: Include reviewer role & experience
includeReviewerInfo.description: Job role / company size and years of experience. Reviewer names are never collected.

aiSummary.title: AI summary per product
aiSummary.description: Adds one AI row per product (sentiment, top pros/cons, complaints). Needs your own OpenAI-compatible or Gemini API key; the AI cost is billed by your provider. Off by default.

aiProvider.title: AI provider
aiProvider.description: Leave empty to auto-detect from the key (Gemini keys start with 'AIza').

aiApiKey.title: AI API key
aiApiKey.description: OpenAI-compatible or Gemini (starts with 'AIza') key. Used only for the AI calls; never logged.

aiBaseUrl.title: AI base URL
aiBaseUrl.description: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenAI, OpenRouter, xAI, Groq…).

aiLanguage.title: AI output language
aiLanguage.description: Language of the AI text (e.g. English, Spanish, Portuguese).
